chunks.subject: AP English Literature
chunks.title: Prose Fiction exemplar — Sample 2A, score 1-4-1 (6/6)
chunks.content: Prose Fiction Analysis (Haien, The All of It — Father Declan) scored 6/6 (Thesis 1, Evidence & Commentary 4, Sophistication 1). Thesis (1): defensible interpretation exhibiting Declan's tortured mind and the struggle to balance self-care with caring for others. Evidence & Commentary (4): specific evidence for all claims ('the blanknesses of solitude...He ought to get a dog'; 'violent flush of self-pity'; 'Innocent, the mere wishing of a mere wish') with commentary consistently explaining how word choice, punctuation, and epanalepsis build meaning. Sophistication (1): sustained exploration of the tension between guilt for bettering one's life and duty to oneself.

chunks.subject: AP English Literature
chunks.title: Prose Fiction exemplar — Sample 2B, score 1-3-0 (4/6)
chunks.content: Prose Fiction Analysis scored 4/6 (Thesis 1, Evidence & Commentary 3, Sophistication 0). Thesis (1): defensible interpretation that imagery and diction show Declan wishing to fix his loneliness but reluctant to act. Evidence & Commentary (3): specific evidence with clear commentary on the rain/fog imagery supports the reasoning — but additional evidence ('bulk emptiness'; Mrs. Duggin's dog-hair line) gets only general commentary, and the diction discussion lacks depth, so short of 4. Sophistication (0): explores the loneliness-vs-pleasing-others struggle without complexity.

chunks.subject: AP English Literature
chunks.title: Prose Fiction exemplar — Sample 2C, score 1-2-0 (3/6)
chunks.content: Prose Fiction Analysis scored 3/6 (Thesis 1, Evidence & Commentary 2, Sophistication 0). Thesis (1): defensible interpretation contrasting Declan's expectations of a priest's joy with his empty reality. Evidence & Commentary (2): some specific evidence ('bulk emptiness' of the 'bleak parish-house'; wishing for a dog) but commentary does not explain how the evidence supports the argument, so no line of reasoning; discussion of juxtaposition/contrast does not contribute to meaning. Sophistication (0): not demonstrated.
